Nora (Support): Escalating P1 -> MapleRetail trial failing onboarding checks; embed ingestion returning 429s since 11:12 UTC. Demo at 16:00 local.
Priya (CSM): Ack. Is the demo blocked?
Nora (Support): Yes, QA hit repeated failures. Sample log: `2026-03-23T11:11:58Z ERROR ingest tenant=mapleretail status=429 quota_remaining=0`
Ken (SRE): Seeing a short quota exhaustion on dedicated pool redwood-ded-2; likely retry storms from their importer. I can temporarily raise quota by 20% and add a short throttle rule.
Theo (CS Ops): Do it. We need a comms note and renewal-watch flag — MapleRetail is on a monthly pilot with expansion potential.
Priya (CSM): Draft status please: short apology, mitigation, ask to pause retries, ETA for confirmation. Customer wants update by 13:30 UTC.
Nora (Support): Draft: "Hi Ella — we identified transient rate limits causing embed failures. We've applied a temporary quota increase and recommend pausing automated retries for 45 minutes while we stabilize. We're prioritizing your demo and will confirm readiness by 13:30 UTC. — Nora, Support"
Priya (CSM): Add a one-line about follow-up post-mortem within 24h.
Ken (SRE): Quota bumped +20% for tenant mapleretail on redwood-ded-2. 429s subsided in last 60s. Creating INC-2026-033-72.
IncBot: Incident INC-2026-033-72 created and assigned to Ken.
Theo (CS Ops): Action items: Priya send status by 13:20, Ken capture KV churn metrics & run post-incident diff, Nora update KB with retry guidance, CS Ops tag account renewal-watch and loop SE for post-demo enablement.
Priya (CSM): I'll send the note and schedule a 10-min pre-demo check at 15:50 local. Adding renewal watch to account doc now.
Nora (Support): Customer asked to confirm when normal. I'll post updates here.
Priya (CSM): Sent to customer. LGTM. Will reopen if errors recur.
